verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for a networking client and control-plane service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or logging opt-out, a usage-tracking control, or a no-logging mode for Tailscale itself. The Pi-hole ad-blocking guide is a user-side setup about third-party ads, not a control over Tailscale's own tracking, so it earns no credit.
